create_ObservabilityConfig: create an ObservabilityConfig instance to configure metrics and tracing for vLLM
test_validate_otlp_traces_endpoint: test the otlp_traces_endpoint validator that checks OpenTelemetry is available before accepting a tracing URL
run_validate_show_hidden_metrics_for_ver: run the show_hidden_metrics_for_version validator that parses and validates version strings
build_ObservabilityConfig_detailed_trace: build an ObservabilityConfig with collect_detailed_traces set to model, worker, or all modules
review_ObservabilityConfig_cached_proper: review the cached properties collect_model_forward_time and collect_model_execute_time that derive from collect_detailed_traces
